summary.adapter_prompt_prefix: OpenFly atomic navigation mode. Three front images are oldest to newest, ending with the current observation. Follow the route and choose the next atomic action. Return exactly one digit: 0=mission stop, 1=forward 3 metres, 2=turn left 30 degrees, 3=turn right 30 degrees, 4=ascend 3 metres, 5=descend 3 metres. These are navigation primitives, not velocities. No odometry or downward image is provided.
summary.prompt_display:
our adapters (smol256, smol500, qwen):
OpenFly atomic navigation mode. Three front images are oldest to newest, ending with the current observation. Follow the route and choose the next atomic action. Return exactly one digit: 0=mission stop, 1=forward 3 metres, 2=turn left 30 degrees, 3=turn right 30 degrees, 4=ascend 3 metres, 5=descend 3 metres. These are navigation primitives, not velocities. No odometry or downward image is provided.
Route: <route instruction>

openfly_vla (model_card style):
<route instruction>
summary.prompt_note: The two families are not asked the same way. Our adapters receive the task framing above followed by 'Route: <instruction>' and must reply with one digit. openfly_vla receives the route instruction alone, in its published model-card style, and emits action tokens.
